title: PHP2Shell build profile
description: Per-build profile with libphp offsets, heap calibration parameters and RCE verification status.

fixed_in.description: First patched version in this branch, or null for EOL branches.

sapi.description: Server API: apache2handler (mod_php prefork) or fpm (nginx + PHP-FPM).

verified.description: Whether the profile has been tested against a real target.

rce.description: True only when a real command proof (uid=...) was obtained.

upstream_profile.description: Upstream exploit profile name passed to exploit.py.

distro.description: Target distribution, e.g. debian, ubuntu, alpine.

libphp.description: Symbol offsets relative to the libphp.so load base (apache2handler) or the php-fpm PIE base (fpm).

zif_system.description: Offset of zif_system (the C handler behind PHP's system()).

zval_ptr_dtor.description: Offset of zval_ptr_dtor (the destructor the stage-3 hijack replaces).

htdata.description: Chunk-relative offset of the 167-byte live string used as stage-3 carrier. Null when stage 3 is not calibrated.

fpm.description: PHP-FPM stale-BG(unserialize) chain layout (lab-calibrated; offsets relative to the php-fpm PIE base).

basic_globals.description: Offset of basic_globals in the php-fpm binary.

reclaim_pads.description: Pad field sizes placed before the big reclaim field.

reclaim_size.description: Size of the big multipart field that reclaims the stale struct.

oracle.description: Calibration oracle used by the lab client (e.g. /proc/<pid>/mem).

no_oracle.description: HTTP-only endgame geometry: no /proc/<pid>/mem is read at exploit time.

reclaim_pads.description: Pad field sizes placed before the big reclaim field.

reclaim_size.description: Size of the big multipart field that reclaims the stale struct.

candidates.description: Candidate (d offset, cover offset) pairs tried in order.

bases.description: How the absolute bases are supplied or derived.

leak.description: HTTP-only base leak geometry (stale short-session string OOB read).

arm_path.description: Builder script that stores the large stale session values (for example /bigvar.php).

pads.description: Field sizes placed before the reclaimed forged header.

header_content_off.description: Offset of the forged zend_string header inside the reclaim content.

read_len.description: Forged string length that spans the stale chunk and PIE pointers.

chunk_ptr_off.description: Offset of the stale zval chunk pointer in the leaked bytes.

chunk_base_off.description: Offset from the chunk pointer to the Zend-MM chunk base.

pie_ptr_off.description: Offset of the leaked execute_ex handler pointer in the leaked bytes.

pie_base_off.description: Offset from the leaked execute_ex handler pointer to the PIE base.

growth.description: geometry of the single-surface amplifier arm (default-installation mode); absent means the classic two-surface arm geometry applies

stages.description: Heap calibration parameters for each exploit stage.

stage1_n.description: Number of multipart fields to place before the forged block in stage 1. Null when not calibrated.

stage1_forge_len.description: Byte length of the forged zend_string block in stage 1. Null when not calibrated.

stage2_t.description: Target field index for the stage-2 libphp pointer leak. Null when not calibrated.

stage2_v.description: Value parameter for stage-2 calibration. Null when not calibrated.

stage3_pads.description: Padding pairs for stage-3 heap grooming. Null when stage 3 is not calibrated.

stage3_carrier.description: Whether the 167-byte carrier string is used. Null when stage 3 is not calibrated.

stage3_cookie.description: Send Cookie: PHPSESSID=<32 bytes> on the stage-3 first request (keeps PS(id) valid and participates in the heap phase on some builds).

stage3_wfields.description: Small fill fields (5-char name, 1-byte value) prepended to the stage-3 first request.

stage3_fake_len.description: Byte length of the fake-reference zend_string value (31 = chars land at R0 on the deb13-apxs2 build; upstream default 55 = chars at R0+8).

stage3_fakes.description: Number of fake-reference fields in the stage-3 reclaim run.

stage3_b_name_len.description: Name length of the stage-3 second-request fields (3-char names shift the reclaim phase versus 31-char names).

stage3_mode.description: Stage-3 variant: 'carrier' (upstream 15-byte bin-40 string), 'lab' (55-byte reference carriers) or 'vessel' (reference pattern embedded in a fake-HashTable blob; see tools/php2shell_vessel.py). Null when stage 3 is not calibrated.

stage3_early.description: Vessel mode: bytes of the S-side early field that steers the dangling reference one page up (bin-13 sized, e.g. 160).

stage3_blobs.description: Vessel mode: number of B2 fake-HashTable blobs (bin-13 allocations).

stage3_vessel_index.description: Vessel mode: index of the B2 blob that carries the embedded reference pattern.

config.description: Target runtime configuration used during calibration.

memory_limit.description: PHP memory_limit in bytes, or -1 for unlimited.

display_errors.description: display_errors setting and how it was determined.

measured.description: Addresses observed during calibration (informational, not used at runtime).

chunk_base.description: Zend MM chunk base address from stage-1 leak. Null when not leaked.

libphp_base.description: libphp.so load base from stage-2 leak. Null when not leaked.

chunk_base_example.description: Example chunk base observed on a similar build (informational).

libphp_base_example.description: Example libphp base observed on a similar build (informational).

stage3_http_session_vars.description: Chunk-relative shape of $_SESSION storage observed during calibration.

stage3_ref_buffers.description: Chunk-relative shape of the reference buffers observed during calibration.

oom_mb.description: OOM body size in MiB passed to the upstream exploit.

oom_margin_mb.description: Margin above memory_limit used to trigger OOM.

memory_limit_tested_mb.description: memory_limit values (in MiB) where RCE was verified.

layout.description: Compiled struct-layout offsets for this PHP-FPM build. The strict per-field shape is validated by profiles/fpm-schema.json; this generic schema only asserts it is an object.

stage3_mode.description: Stage-3 variant: 'carrier' (upstream 15-byte bin-40 string), 'lab' (55-byte reference carriers) or 'vessel' (reference pattern embedded in a fake-HashTable blob; see tools/php2shell_vessel.py). Null when stage 3 is not calibrated.
